flags.message: F9 (IRGC retaliation by Sep 7, p=0.68) was opened on Sep 1, but Iran launched operations against US interests in Aqaba, Jordan on the same day. If IRGC attribution against a confirmed US military installation is verified by CENTCOM or two independent TIER1 sources, F9 should immediately be transitioned to RESOLVED-YES. Owner must confirm attribution before the next scheduled run.

F1 (Iran MFA Hormuz conditions by EOD Sep 2) expires tomorrow. Probability at 0.06 (near-floor). No further Analyst action required unless an MFA statement is observed before EOD Sep 2. If no statement is confirmed, transition to RESOLVED-NO at next run.

DA subagent was unavailable for the third consecutive session due to container restarts (agents lost: a6f68ee375c970156, a3c9ab318df288f48, a9449d8004803d10c).
